dayConvention: Day numbering: the first day with impressions is day 1, and the first N days are days 1 to N. Stage bands: 1-3, 4-7, 8-14, 15-30, 31+. A learning reset restarts the count at day 1 on the reset date. All in the account timezone.
note: Moshi launched today, 2026-10-06, so today is day 1. Window is partial.
dataSource: The tree is get_ad_account_tree (references/meta-reads.md). Ad set 1202620000000020 has adCount 14 in the tree, but 2 of its ads were paused before the window, so T1's adsOverMaxAds is 12: gold adCount 12. The retargeting campaign was paused on 2026-10-02 (status PAUSED, ad set CAMPAIGN_PAUSED), so its ad set carries no live settings: objective other, and optimizationGoal, learning, lastLearningReset and attributionSetting null. The Moshi ad set reports LEARNING (learning: "learning"). T1, T3 and T4 carry the expected ads_over_max_ads flag, which stays out of flags[].
knownArtifact: Known artifact carried over from the Meta Ads MCP fixtures: the mature merchant campaigns' 30-day totals (T1 metrics) keep the old campaign-read numbers, so their non-top ads imply implausible rates, and T3's top ads do not add up to them (for example day21 Evergreen: top three ROAS 0.61 against 2.6 for the campaign). Do not fail a run that notices this or declines to use those totals.
